name: Eroi
source:
Souji is a doctor. He has a secret that his another personality comes out when he examines a female patient. When it appears, he only thinks of having sex with her. He can't control it. He quit his job before, but he is employed by a hospital and starts working there. "I really hope it never comes out again...."

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090510102254/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003167]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
宗司是一名医生。他有一个秘密：为女患者检查身体时，另一个人格便会出现。这个人格一旦现身，脑中就只想着与患者发生关系，宗司完全无法控制。此前他曾因此辞去工作，如今又受聘于一家医院，重新开始行医生涯。“真希望它再也不要出现…”

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090510102254/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003167]ErogeShop[/url]]
